name: Uchikawa Mima no Aishuu -Jikan Kanshou Ryokou no Shoujo-tachi No.3-
original_name: 内河観魔の愛執 ー時間感傷旅行の少女たち Ｎｏ．3ー
source:
When a bullied schoolgirl Manami is trying to commit suicide, a time traveler girl appears. 
The eternal love across generations...and the Naikan therapy to know the phylogeny of life.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE234309.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
遭受欺凌的女学生真奈美试图自杀时，一名时间旅行女孩出现。跨越世代的永恒之爱，以及认识生命系谱的内观疗法。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE234309.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
